notes: save/restore live on MiniCPMO (base model, lines 1586/1688), NOT on MiniCPMODuplex. Both dup_a and dup_b share the same base.model reference (MiniCPMODuplex.from_existing_model stores it as instance.model). save_speculative_snapshot() is only auto-called by streaming_generate when enable_speculative_snapshot=True (line 1984), which is False by default — so has_speculative_snapshot() returns False in normal duplex flow. Even if called manually on base, _speculative_snapshot is a single slot on base: session A save overwrites session B save. Per-session rollback in single-load mode is structurally impossible. Dual-load (separate base model per session) is required for per-session snapshot isolation.
